sentences.text: When someone falls overboard, the first seconds matter most.
Shout man overboard, and point at the person, and keep pointing.
Throw flotation immediately, a ring buoy, cushion, anything that floats, which also marks the spot.
Press the man overboard button on your GPS.
Turn the boat toward the side the person fell from, which swings the stern and propellers away from them.
Assign one person whose only job is to keep their eyes and arm on the person in the water, because a head in waves disappears from sight within seconds.
